      "text": "recomputing weight in the estimator leaves the same witness-mismatch false positive unaddressed in block policy, whereas filtering in removeForBlock could cleanly fix both",
      "quote": "Rather than recomputing weight from the connected block, I think there's a cleaner fix that covers both",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the stack to require exact wtxid matching in removeForBlock as requested",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5802096604",
        "c:5823154747"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5823154747",
      "status_by_quote": "Updated the stack to calculate coverage from mined transaction weights in one block walk, then require an exact wtxid ma"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5828369388",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "drop the mempool estimator refactor and changes, as fixing the false positive in removeForBlock naturally works for both fee estimators",
      "quote": "This should be simplified, we do not need the refactor and the changes in the mempool estimator at all.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained why retaining the one-pass accounting aids review and consistency with GetMempoolHealth",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5843201371"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5843201371",
      "status_by_quote": "While there is a fix with a smaller diff, the separate sums before made it easy for us to miss that a txid match could have a different witness"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5828369388",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add a test indicating the effects of the fix for block_policy",
      "quote": "We should also have a test that indicates the effects of the fix for `block_policy` as well.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author noted adding that check to remove_for_block_witness_mismatch",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5843201371"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5843201371",
      "status_by_quote": "I added that check to `remove_for_block_witness_mismatch`: the block policy estimator no longer records the local variant as confirmed."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5793157228",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",

      "reason": "fixing the false positive will naturally work for both fee rate estimators",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "mempool estimator",
        "removeForBlock",
        "block_policy"
      ]
    }
  ],

      "what": "ismaelsadeeq to re-review following author's response on keeping the refactor and test addition",

    }
  ],
  "notes": "l0rinc answered ismaelsadeeq's two suggestions in c:5843201371, declining the suggestion to drop the refactor and confirming the test check was added."
